name: biobb_mddb Clusters
title: Wrapper of the Clusters analysis from MDDB workflow module.
description: Cluster the frames of the trajectory according to the conformation of every interaction and find the transitions between clusters. A screenshot is generated for every cluster. Interactions must be defined, either through the interactions property or the inputs file.

pbc_selection.description: Atom selection (VMD syntax) of atoms under Periodic Boundary Conditions (e.g. solvent, ions, membrane lipids), which are excluded from the analysis. Use 'auto' to guess them. If not set, the value in the inputs file is used, or 'auto' by default.

cg_selection.description: Atom selection (VMD syntax) of Coarse Grained beads. Use 'auto' to guess them. If not set, the value in the inputs file is used, or none by default.

interactions.description: List of interactions to be analyzed. Each interaction is a dictionary with the fields name, agent_1, selection_1, agent_2, selection_2 and optionally distance_cutoff (Å). Selections are in VMD syntax. If not set, interactions in the inputs file are used.

md_type.description: Type of molecular dynamics. If not set, the value in the inputs file is used, or 'trajectory' by default.

property_formats.name: ensemble
property_formats.description: Frames are not related in time

framestep.description: Time between consecutive frames in nanoseconds (ns). If not set, the value in the inputs file is used.

binary_path.description: Path to the MDDB workflow executable binary.

restart.description: Do not execute if output files exist.

sandbox_path.description: Parent path to the sandbox directory.

container_path.description: Path to the binary executable of your container.

container_volume_path.description: Path to an internal directory in the container.

container_working_dir.description: Path to the internal CWD in the container.

container_user_id.description: User number id to be mapped inside the container.

container_shell_path.description: Path to the binary executable of the container shell.
